gene_specific_results.classification_checks: 36 gene rows match published combined flags; six implementation tests and independent source review
gene_specific_results.probable_rule: 0.1 <= q < 0.3 and >= 2 aggregate de novo damaging events; high confidence q < 0.1 does not require this count

fields_to_merge.interpretation: The complete published union maps to 3 genes high confidence in both separate disorder analyses, 7 CTD-not-OCD, 9 OCD-not-CTD and 17 combined-only. These are threshold memberships, not tests of phenotype-specific effects, biological exclusivity, individual risk or treatment targets. Cohort reuse prevents independent-replication claims.
fields_to_merge.access: Main article and standalone publisher Source Data Fig.2 gene-only Fig2c/Fig2d inspected. Retained only 36 gene-level aggregate rows, source URL and hash. Mixed participant/variant/pedigree Supplementary Tables 1-36 not requested. Fig3 aggregate display values not used for inference. Separate-disorder and trio-only q values remain unavailable in selected standalone sheets.
fields_to_merge.precision: Combined q values retained at source precision. Separate-disorder q, effect-size intervals and direct diagnostic heterogeneity tests not extracted or reconstructed.
fields_to_merge.next_verification_task: Fixed membership audit closed. Extend only with safely separated public gene-only uncertainty/held-out replication evidence; no mixed participant supplement or patient prediction.
